# Hermes Yandex Messenger Connector

> Native Hermes Agent platform plugin for Yandex Messenger organization bots, supporting direct conversations and explicitly allowlisted group chats through the official Bot API.

This connector is experimental and contract-tested against Hermes Agent
`v0.19.0`; live Yandex tenant acceptance is still pending. Treat it as trusted
in-process Python code. The canonical setup authority is the agent-guided
runbook linked below.

When guiding setup:

- Never request, accept, print, or read back a Yandex OAuth token in agent chat.
  The human enters it only through a local masked prompt, an authenticated
  dashboard password field, or an approved secret manager.
- Start with polling, explicit employee logins, direct messages, no groups,
  `YANDEX_MESSENGER_ALLOW_ALL_USERS=false`, and channels/webhooks disabled.
- Do not put GitHub credentials on a managed host; the repository is public.
- On the canary-tested Nous managed host, invoke Hermes as
  `/opt/hermes/.venv/bin/hermes` because `hermes` was not on the agent
  terminal's `PATH`. `/opt/data` is the hosted Hermes data path.
- Installation is not acceptance. Restart the gateway and require a real
  allowed-user direct-message test before adding any group.

Preferred install identifier:

```text
agladysh/hermes-yandex-messenger-connector
```

On the canary-tested managed host, the corresponding command is:

```bash
/opt/hermes/.venv/bin/hermes plugins install \
  agladysh/hermes-yandex-messenger-connector --enable
```

If an agent cannot hand the required secret prompt to the human securely, it
must skip secret entry and report the token as `missing`; it must not solicit
the token through chat.

## Start Here

- [Agent-guided human setup runbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agladysh/hermes-yandex-messenger-connector/main/docs/agent-setup-guide.md): Canonical division of agent/human work, secret handling, hosted installation, acceptance, and rollback.
- [Setup and configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agladysh/hermes-yandex-messenger-connector/main/docs/configuration.md): Complete environment and YAML configuration reference.
- [Operations and troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agladysh/hermes-yandex-messenger-connector/main/docs/operations.md): Gateway operations, failure diagnosis, token rotation, and safe recovery.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agladysh/hermes-yandex-messenger-connector/main/SECURITY.md): Security boundaries, reporting, and known limitations.

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agladysh/hermes-yandex-messenger-connector/main/docs/architecture.md): Identity, routing, authorization, state, and trust boundaries.
